evidence: Frozen-source review against C#, the full implementation patch, and parent verification of 56 tests and a Windows debug build. No fresh captures, hardware runs or five-platform proof.
improvements: Altitude-only mission flag with ACK, rejection and timeout reporting.
Button mappings and principal parameters, held-button suppression on ordinary enable, manual packets and extension-channel RC release.
Pending takeoff is cancelled on stop and waits for Guided telemetry.
patch_findings: Pending altitude change survives vehicle selection; retry/ACK ownership can cross targets.
Controller switching and imported/remapped settings can create false press edges.
Altitude change sends only MISSION_ITEM_INT; the reference defaults to legacy MISSION_ITEM.
Simultaneous actions overwrite the single pending command ACK/retry state.
Relay OFF is lost when controls stop before the release edge.
Camera action lacks the reference legacy DIGICAM_CONTROL fallback.
remaining_blockers: Control transaction isolation and controller lifecycle correctness.
Joystick raw axes/buttons, calibration, firmware profiles and gimbal point tracking.
Bidirectional display/input unit conversion across PLAN, DATA actions, gauges and Status.
Native mobile file and USB serial adapters, installable iOS wrapper and five-platform validation.
Operational Planner identity, directories, reset, language, layout and password controls.
Multiple physical links and packed mission MAVFTP transfer.
Plugin execution, compatible scripting object model and actual DroneCAN interface.
GStreamer/HereLink, rendered HUD recording, geocoding and current visual comparison.
